title: How To Keep Your Muscle While You Lose Fat
hook: Lose the fat. Keep the muscle you worked to build.
body:
Weight loss medication made it harder for me to eat enough protein. When my strength started dropping, I knew the scale was not telling me the whole story.

Here is how I approach resistance training, protein-first meals and tracking my lifts while losing fat. I also share my own Zepbound experience.
close:
Watch the full video, then start recording your body weight, sets and reps. My medication experience is personal, not medical advice. Talk with your doctor before changing your medication.

Some clips are labeled AI-GENERATED visualizations.
